hero.alt_lt: Moteris smėlio spalvos paltu ir plačiomis kelnėmis lėtai eina per saulėtą akmeninę kolonadą
hero.notes: Pexels video 7681897, 720p variant (1080p = 16.8 MB, too heavy). Camera tracks back as the model walks toward it through a stone colonnade; she stays mid-frame for the whole 24 s, so the loop jump is mild. Bright daylight stone: needs a strong bottom-left dark gradient (about 70-80% black at bottom-left) for white h1. On portrait/mobile crops keep object-position near 47% so the model stays visible. Alternates: (1) MART PRODUCTION 7253202 https://www.pexels.com/video/man-walking-outside-7253202/ (man in camel coat and black turtleneck walking toward camera across a lit plaza at dusk, already dark and moody, 18 s, 1920x1080 7.18 MB / 1280x720 3.73 MB; matches jam.jpg); (2) Mikhail Nilov 7681901 https://www.pexels.com/video/video-of-a-waman-walking-7681901/ (same shoot, woman in trench walking away under a colonnade, 11 s, 1920x1080 2.77 MB).

hero-poster.alt_lt: Moteris smėlio spalvos paltu ir plačiomis kelnėmis lėtai eina per saulėtą akmeninę kolonadą
hero-poster.notes: Exact first frame (t=0) of hero.mp4, upscaled from 1280 to 1920 with light sharpening, so the poster-to-video swap shows no visible jump. Preload this one.

ambient.alt_lt: Ranka lėtai perbraukia ant pakabų kabančius vilnonius ir languotus švarkus
ambient.notes: Pexels video 6036310, 720p (1080p = 12.4 MB). Close-up of hands browsing a rail of charcoal, navy and camel-check tailoring; warm and tactile. Works under a 55-65% dark overlay in the Išpardavimas band. Content stays the same close-up all the way through, so it loops cleanly. Alternates: Naresh Babu 35415156 https://www.pexels.com/video/brown-blazer-in-low-light-setting-35415156/ (brown blazer on a hanger under a warm wall lamp, very slow, 10 s, 1920x1080 2.26 MB, lighter beige tone); Ba Tik 3753696 https://www.pexels.com/video/a-woman-parting-the-clothes-in-the-clothes-line-3753696/ (model's face appears as she parts a rack of coats, 17 s, 1280x720 4.86 MB).

ambient-poster.alt_lt: Ranka lėtai perbraukia ant pakabų kabančius vilnonius ir languotus švarkus
ambient-poster.notes: First frame (t=0) of ambient.mp4, upscaled to 1920 with light sharpening.

jai.alt_lt: Moteris kupranugario spalvos lietpalčiu atveria tamsias medines duris
jai.notes: Woman in a camel trench in a dark wood doorway with warm, low light. Dark left and bottom edges suit the huge Bodoni 'Jai' at bottom-left. She carries no bag. If a handbag shot is required, alternate: Dennis Akintade 36278062 https://www.pexels.com/photo/36278062/ (black coat and black top-handle bag at a burgundy door). Pairs with jam.jpg: both camel coats, warm interior/arcade light.

jam.alt_lt: Vyras karamelės spalvos paltu ir juodu golfu stovi šiltai apšviestoje arkadoje
jam.notes: Man in a camel overcoat and black turtleneck, glasses, holding a bag at his side; warm lamp-lit arcade. Same palette as jai.jpg (camel and black). Bottom third is coat and dark trousers, so white text reads well with a light scrim. Alternates: Faruk Tokluoğlu 7312540 https://www.pexels.com/photo/7312540/ (beige coat, grey stone wall, moodier); Mahmood Alhussein 34002215 (studio, beige coat, brown knit).

vaikams.alt_lt: Mergaitė smėlio spalvos paltuku laiko geltonų klevo lapų puokštę rudens parke
vaikams.notes: Girl in a beige trench and rust skirt holding maple leaves in front of her face; muted autumn forest with a soft dark background. Child fully clothed and not posed at the camera, so the shot is tasteful. Chosen over brighter orange autumn shots for campaign consistency. Alternates: iddea photo 34104457 (two kids in knits, saturated golden leaves); Mukhtar Shuaib Mukhtar 29389008 (girl in a beige trench, close-up).

lookbook.alt_lt: Moteris ilgu tamsiai žaliu paltu, plačiomis kelnėmis ir baltais sportbačiais eina su pinta rankine
lookbook.notes: Full body, walking in profile against a brick/stone facade and balustrade. Calm, desaturated look. Suggested hotspot positions (left%, top%) in the uncropped image: 1) coat 44% 45%, 2) woven knot handbag 35% 67%, 3) white sneaker 73% 89%. Keep object-fit so these stay visible; with heavy cropping, use object-position 45% 50%. No visible logos. Alternate: Вальдемар 6344593 (black coat, black bag, knee boots in an arcade).

sale-bg.alt_lt: Drabužių kabykla su švarkais ir paltais prieblandoje, ant sienos krenta šviesos ruožas
sale-bg.notes: Very dark, moody rack of jackets with one warm shaft of window light at top-right. Ideal under white text: the left and centre are already near-black, so a 40-50% overlay is enough. Average colour is about #443D37. A guitar neck is faintly visible at the right edge and disappears under the overlay. Alternate: Terje Sollie 298864 https://www.pexels.com/photo/298864/ (folded knitwear and brown brogues on a dark wood shelf).

story.alt_lt: Siuvėjas matavimo juosta tikrina tamsaus švarko atlapą ant manekeno
story.notes: Atelier detail of a hand and tape measure on a charcoal tailored jacket on a mannequin, with a white shirt and black tie. It conveys craft and authenticity for the 'Kodėl Brandstore' (originals guarantee) section. In a 5/12 column crop keep the tape and lapel (object-position 60% 40%). Alternate: same photographer 6766360 (stacked suiting fabrics).

newsletter.alt_lt: Sulankstyti kreminės ir smėlio spalvos megzti megztiniai iš arti
newsletter.notes: Soft, low-contrast stack of cream and oatmeal knits. Works under a light scrim with ink text. Fine knit detail makes it the heaviest file (q74, 642 KB). If a smaller file is needed it can be served at 1600 px wide with no visible loss behind a scrim. Alternate: Magda Ehlers 36198549 (draped camel knit).

accessories.alt_lt: Moteris juodu paltu laiko rudą odinę rankinę su atvartu
accessories.notes: Close crop of a brown leather flap bag held against a black wool coat and cream knit, with burgundy nails. No logo. Quiet luxury tone that matches the jai and lookbook palette. Used as the tall editorial tile in Naujienos. Alternates (same Berna series): 19354614 (bag on long strap); 16747158 (studio still life of a black bag on dark brown).

sneakers.alt_lt: Balti sportbačiai ir platėjantys džinsai ant tamsaus grindinio
sneakers.notes: Off-white chunky sneakers with raw-hem denim on dark paving; low-key light with no visible brand marks. Dark background works for white overlay text. Alternates: Portraits By PB 38181265 (cream sneakers on a striped wooden step, warmer); Konstantin Mishchenko 33015385 (full-length black outfit with white sneakers against stone).

outerwear.alt_lt: Vyras smėlio spalvos ir moteris konjako spalvos paltu eina rudenine miesto gatve
outerwear.notes: Couple seen from behind in camel and cognac coats with a dark scarf, on a warm brick city street with bare trees. Matches the hero, jai and jam palette. A small storefront sign reading 'rain' sits upper-right: crop it out on wide banners (object-position 45% 60%) or cover it with the text scrim. Alternate: MART PRODUCTION 7222721 (cropped coats walking, no faces); Gustavo Fring 7155849 (couple in beige coats, snowy old town).
